name: Silver anodized cover surrogate
description: A neutral metallic surrogate for an undyed anodized cover or joint housing.
scope: Native v2 appearance libraries store uniform PBR values. The GLB carries the richer authored portable material; new image maps are external runtime resources, not automatically installed in SolidCraft.
preview_scope: Actual SolidCraft GPU image; 64 samples, denoised. Read the receipt/variant; this is not a convergence or full-physics claim.
